_notes: Contest OVERNIGHT (1DTE) settings on the judged account PA3P2XKS194E, adopted 2026-09-01 after two findings: the weekly Friday entry (3% OTM, 7 days) quoted $0.08 at ~10% IV and was floor-skipped, and intraday 0DTE pays pennies at this vol - the premium is overnight (same 0.6%-OTM strike: ~$0.07 expiring today vs ~$0.65 expiring tomorrow). Cycle: enter Tue-Thu 09:45-14:30 ET selling the NEXT trading day's expiry 0.6% OTM (gate may widen to otmAlt 1%), buy back at 09:40 ET on expiry morning, re-enter at 09:45. No Friday entry - Thursday's spread is bought back Fri 09:40 ET (07:40 MT) so the account is flat when the lablab submission closes at 09:00 MT. The original weekly config was entryDays [5], entryTime 14:00, otmPct 0.03, creditFloor 0.25, expiryOverride null. The rehearsal week (Aug 24-27, account PA3OB3FIBDS1) used entryDays [2,5] and expiryOverride 2026-09-04; its state is in state.rehearsal.json.
